fields.Name: Sales: Deal Cycle Time
fields.UserQuestion: How long do deals take to close, and does that differ for wins and losses?
fields.Description: Average and median days to close (master plan §9.3 measure 6), reported separately for wins and losses because they measure different things — time-to-win is a sales-cycle measure, time-to-lose is a qualification measure, and a team that loses fast is healthier than one that loses slowly.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Deal. Window on ActualCloseDate; duration measured from the EARLIEST evidence the deal existed — its creation stamp or its first DealStageEvent, whichever is earlier. That is not the obvious column and the reason matters: __mj_CreatedAt is when the ROW was written, so imported history (whose ChangedAt values are preserved) would otherwise produce negative cycle times. Measured on demo data: both closed deals close in July against an 18 Aug creation stamp. Median via PERCENTILE_CONT, because one enterprise deal moves a mean far more than a median at these deal counts.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Selling company. Omit for every company. Deal.CompanyID is server-stamped from the pipeline, so it is always present and never needs a fallback.

fields.Name: PipelineID
fields.Description: One pipeline. Omit for all pipelines.

fields.Name: PeriodStart
fields.Description: Inclusive start of the window. Omit for no lower bound.

fields.Name: PeriodEnd
fields.Description: Inclusive end of the window. Omit for no upper bound.
